title: Inventory payload
description: The payload a `kind: inventory` fetcher writes (the envelope's `payload`). Only the outer shape is fixed: each fetcher chooses its own record fields, and a Paramify inventory pipeline maps them to Inventory fields. Checked by framework/inventory.py when the output is enveloped. See docs/inventory_fetchers.md.

data.description: One record per asset. The inventory pipeline's data path is `payload.data`.

unique_asset_identifier.description: The asset's stable ID in its own system (an ARN, an Azure resource ID). Unique within the file: the pipeline matches Inventory items on it.

records_included.description: False when the fetcher withheld its records because collection was incomplete. `data` is then empty.
